text:
Mira Chen: Heads-up — AurumRetail renewal in ~6 weeks. Noticed a steep usage drop last 30d: API tokens/month from ~450k to ~120k. Customer (Ava) said they're running a short evaluation of NimbleServe for latency and cost. Putting this in triage, need quick plan.

Devin Patel: Ack. Do we have the exact usage timeline + top routes?

Mira Chen: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/aurumretail/usage (internal link)
Snapshot:
```
30d total tokens: 120,432
60d total tokens: 512,341
Top routes (last 90d): /product-describe, /search-rerank
```
A drop starts around 2029-11-03. Ava said their dev lead is testing a pilot with NimbleServe for latency <50ms.

Samir O'Neill: Thanks. A few quick checks: 1) Are they on a quantized runtime variant? if they tried a lower-latency variant that increased cost, could explain shift. 2) Any errors or rate-limit spikes? 3) Have we shipped the latest batching improvements to their dedicated pool?

Mira Chen: No recent config changes on our side. Error rate is fine. ops-bot flagged a transient 502 spike on 2029-11-04 (5m window). Not sure that's causal.

ops-bot: Incident note: 2029-11-04 11:14 UTC — 502 spike on aurumretail-prod, 5m, 3.2% errors, auto-recovered.

Devin Patel: Suggest we do: 1) Re-engage dev champion (Ava) for a quick sync to understand why they paused usage. 2) Run a short latency comparison with them — demo p95 improvement tactics (routing + model variant) and show cost tradeoffs. 3) Prep renewal risk note for AE + CS leadership.

Ravi Shah: I can draft a 1-slide ROI showing cost/latency tradeoff vs NimbleServe. If they're evaluating primarily on latency, we should show two playbooks: low-latency (higher cost) and cost-efficient (caching + batching).

Samir O'Neill: Tech win ideas: a) On-call pair to reproduce their latency test, b) Provide a short config diff and a live 15-min test to show p95 improvements, c) Offer a 30-day pilot of our Dedicated burst pool at discounted rate to match their target latency for their critical routes.

Mira Chen: OK owners/timeboxes:
- Mira: schedule customer 30-min sync by EOD tomorrow (owner)
- Devin: assemble renewal risk summary + competitor notes by Tue EOD
- Samir: prepare a 15-min latency test plan + config diff by Mon noon
- Ravi: ROI slide draft by Mon EOD

Devin Patel: Noted. Any known contacts at NimbleServe? Might help counter specific claims.

Mira Chen: Ava mentioned their dev lead (Marco) is running the pilot. I'll ask for Marco's test criteria.

Samir O'Neill: Also check their model variant requests — if they're moving to shorter context lengths it could reduce token volume, not necessarily churn. Might be a product shift.

Mira Chen: Good point. I'll ask if they're trimming routes.

Ravi Shah: If we get them back to comparable latency, offer a short-term discount + a joint perf review. Keeps procurement engaged.

Devin Patel: I'll also create a quick competitive matrix (NimbleServe vs Redwood) focused on latency, cost, integration effort, SLAs.

Mira Chen: Thanks team. I'll post meeting invite once I hear back from Ava. If anyone uncovers a smoking gun (billing, SLA, or new internal tool), drop it here. :thumbsup:

Samir O'Neill: +1. I'll queue an infra runbook and be ready for the live test this week.

ops-bot: Reminder: Renewal for AurumRetail scheduled 2029-12-15. Current account tier: Dedicated Standard.

Devin Patel: 👍 closing loop — I'll flag this as "priority:high" in the renewal tracker and link the action items.

Mira Chen: Perfect. Short updates in thread as items progress.
